description: Defines enums, conversion functions, and constants related to Open Fronthaul message properties, including data direction, resource block types, symbol increment types, filter index types, and section types within the ocudu::ofh namespace.

methods.name: to_value
methods.description: Converts enum values to unsigned integers.

methods.name: to_filter_index_type
methods.description: Converts an unsigned index to a filter_index_type enum.

methods.name: is_a_prach_message
methods.description: Checks if a filter_index_type corresponds to a PRACH message.
